title: Ingot Casting Machine
equipment: ENTEC Industrial Furnaces ingot casting machine: chain mould conveyor, 5 HP motor with Sumiko SU-412 gearbox on a 5 HP VFD, distributor, water sprays and cooling tower, discharge hammers
summary: Operating simulator: the preparations and preheat, the VFD panel and potentiometer, the pour from the furnace matched to the conveyor speed, spray cooling, hammers and discharge temperature, with the manual's warnings (water on the moulds, abrupt potentiometer, ingot riding round) and its vibration troubleshooting. English and Arabic.
